description: Follows a girl who agrees to a seven-day relationship with her school’s playboy to save her boyfriend (Just in case you didn’t watch the series, the bad guy set a trap for the heroine and her boyfriend, the bad guy saved both of them, but heroine’s boyfriend is badly hurt and is current under the bad guy’s care…in short she blackmailed and fucked up). But, this situation holds a secret about her true identity. New characters, such as a secretary, police officer, and senior classmate, add to the excitement as the story progresses. The second day of their relationship brings unexpected events. While the cover may show a heart-wrenching goodbye, a swimsuit scene will be included in a future episode. Brace yourself for an emotional journey in this captivating anime.
